purpose: Explore modestly larger tensile and Green-shear strains; not a new training box or final surrogate test
scope: Predeclared exploratory endpoints on unchanged 4621/8961 meshes. Stop a path after failure or a failed physical screen; preserve attempts and do not treat nonconvergence as proof of physical instability. No further extension in this experiment. Nonlinearity is descriptive, with no threshold used to select a geometry or model.
